selection_rule: sorted(basename for images/val/*.jpg), random.Random(seed).sample(files, count), sorted
mapping_rule: Each category permits its exact ontology counterpart plus the broader parent vehicle where one exists; categories outside the ontology are ineligible, not errors.
known_limitations: Elevated oblique view of a pool, not nadir aerial.
Swimmers are annotated; most spectators and officials on deck are not, so precision is a very loose bound. Sensitivity on known positives is the measurable quantity.
Caps are parts of annotated swimmers and are excluded from denominators.
